## ZGTA V — TrollStore installer

**Build 88 test candidate · by zema.**

Install this package in Sileo to download the exact verified IPA and pass it to your existing TrollStore or TrollStore Lite installer. It checks size and SHA-256 before installation.

Requires a compatible TrollStore setup and your own game files. An existing non-TrollStore app with the same identifier is not forcibly overwritten.

### Updates and removal
TrollStore updates the existing app bundle. Keep the app and its game files/saves. Removing this installer package leaves the TrollStore app and its data in place; manage app removal in TrollStore.

### Verification
15 local installer tests (including AppSync fallback cases) and Debian archive checks pass. Actual Sileo → TrollStore installation on a phone is still pending. If installation fails, send the Sileo log. This package uses only TrollStore. A separate experimental AppSync package is available for compatible rootful jailbreaks; it is not needed on your TrollStore device.

### Installer 0.88-1
- Initial Sileo → TrollStore candidate.
- Pinned Build 88 download and integrity checks.
- Native TrollStore install/custom interface; no force flag.
- Installer removal preserves the app and data.
